sentences.en: The model was featured on the cover of the glamor magazine.
sentences.zh: 这位模特登上了时尚杂志的封面。

sentences.en: The city has a certain glamor that attracts tourists.
sentences.zh: 这个城市有一种魅力能让游客慕名而来。

sentences.en: For many, the idea of adventure holds a great deal of glamor.
sentences.zh: 对很多人来说，冒险的概念充满了诱惑力。

senses.zh: 魅力；魔法；迷人的美（等于 glamour）
迷惑；使有魅力（等于 glamour）
